import_story.title: SO-V29-03 S2 Shadow Polish
import_story.description: v2.9 03 S2 plan-size shadow corpus: the 02 S6 guild hall with three self-voiced members, delivery on, reply polish in shadow.

roster.name: Luke
roster.role: a young adventurer looking for his brother

polish.notes: Fast, breathless sentences that trip over each other when he is nervous. Asks a question, then answers it himself. Ties things back to finding his brother.
Plain, weighty words. Wraps advice in a short story from his younger days. A bark that ends in a laugh. Never sugarcoats a risk, always offers a way forward.
Quick, teasing one-liners that hide worry. Says less than he means.

qualities.rubric: Has the party left the guild hall?
